slides.h: FESTIVAL SEASON IS WON [[60 DAYS OUT]]
slides.dek: A countdown checklist so October feels calm while everyone else scrambles.

items: **Commit your bestseller reorder now.** Supplier lead times stretch every festival season.
**Cap the experiments.** One new product this season at most, funded from profit.
**Agree return terms with your supplier in writing** before volumes go up.
**Reshoot your top 5 product photos.** Festival buyers scroll fast and buy from pictures.
**Rewrite titles with the gifting words** buyers search in season.
**Plan 2 bundles.** Gift-ready pairs at a clean price point outsell singles in season.
**Order packaging material for peak volume now.** It sells out too.
**Compare courier rates again.** Festival surcharges appear without notice.
**Set your COD limit.** Decide the order value above which you ask for prepaid.
**Lock prices and stop reflex discounting.** A festival buyer pays for availability.
**Keep a cash buffer for returns.** RTO peaks two weeks after the sale peaks.
**Pre-write your buyer replies.** Delivery date, size, exchange. Speed converts.
**Count stock every morning.** Overselling costs more than underselling.
**Dispatch same day, every day.** Reviews this month decide next season.
**Launch nothing new.** Sale week runs on rails you already built.

slides.h: SAVE THIS. WORK IT WEEK BY WEEK.
slides.body: One stage at a time. Your festival season is already on the calendar.
